{{Quote|I've encountered the Rebels on many occasions. The first encounter was during a peacekeeping mission on Ryloth where they ambushed my squad.|[[TK329]]|<ref name="TK329" />}}
A peacekeeping '''mission on Ryloth''' was carried out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces ambushed a squad of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], including [[TK329]].<ref name="TK329" />
